outline:
This course is a weekly seminar discusses the current progress of individual projects.
Sometimes we need to visit a specific showcase to understand current interactive technologies and innovative applications, just like  Huashan 1914 Creative Park, Songshan Cultural and Creative Park and National Taiwan Science Education Center in Taipei.
schedule:
Week 1        Course Introduction
Week 2        Field Trip: Visit AVR School  &Taipei Fine Arts Museum
Week 3        Field Trip: Visit AVR School  &Taipei Fine Arts Museum
Week 4        Seminar talk
Week 5        Field Trip:Visit Huashan 1914 Creative Park
Week 6        Field Trip:Visit Huashan 1914 Creative Park
Week 7        Seminar talk
Week 8        Field Trip:Visit Songshan Cultural and Creative Park
Week 9        Field Trip:Visit Songshan Cultural and Creative Park
Week 10      Field Trip:Visit Songshan Cultural and Creative Park
Week 11       Seminar Talk
Week 12       group discussion
Week 13       group discussion
Week 14       Visit MOCA Taipei
Week 15       Visit MOCA Taipei
Week 16       Visit MOCA Taipei
Week 17       Seminar Talk
Week 18      Final term review

* The actual schedule of the site visiting/ field trip will be adjusted according to the related exhibition theme, details will be announced during the class.
assessment:
60%  Participation of visiting
15%  Class attendance and discussion
25%  Visiting report
